conj.s: I studied hard, ___ I still felt nervous before the test.
Hurry up, ___ you will miss the bus.
___ it was raining, we played football outside.
She stayed at home ___ she had a bad cold.
The shop was closed, ___ we went to another one.
I'm not sure ___ he will come to the party.
___ I feel sad, I listen to my favorite song.
You can eat ___ you like. There is a lot of food.
Wear a jacket, ___ you'll feel cold on the mountain.
He is very rich, ___ he never seems happy.
___ she was tired, she finished all her homework.
It was very hot, ___ we turned on the fan.
We will go to the beach ___ it is sunny tomorrow.
I don't know ___ to laugh or cry.

pronoun.text: Ben has a little sister. **She** loves drawing animals. Every evening Ben helps **her** with **her** homework, and then **they** watch cartoons together.
Many students feel nervous before exams. **This** is normal. Teachers say **it** helps to sleep well. **Some** also listen to music to relax, but **others** prefer to read.
The city built a new park last year. **It** has a big lake. Families go **there** on weekends, and **many** bring food for picnics. The mayor said **this** was the best project of **his** career.
Dr. Nam met two students in the library. **He** asked **them** about **their** project. **One** wanted to study robots; **the other** was interested in plants.

wordform.why: ขยายกริยา answered ต้องเป็น adverb (-ly)

wordform.s: His ___ surprised everyone in the room.
wordform.why: หลัง His ต้องเป็นคำนาม

wordform.s: It was a very ___ day for our team.
wordform.why: หน้าคำนาม day ต้องเป็น adjective

wordform.s: ___ English every day helps you improve.
wordform.why: ตำแหน่งประธานที่เป็น 'การกระทำ' ใช้ V-ing (gerund)

wordform.s: The ___ of the bridge took three years.
wordform.why: หลัง The ต้องเป็นคำนาม 'การสร้าง' = building (builder = คนสร้าง ความหมายไม่เข้า)

wordform.s: He felt ___ after he lied to his mother.
wordform.why: ความรู้สึกของคนหลัง felt ใช้ ashamed (shameful = น่าละอาย ใช้บรรยายการกระทำ)

wordform.s: Please drive ___. The road is wet.
wordform.why: ขยายกริยา drive ต้องเป็น adverb
หลัง her ต้องเป็นคำนาม

wordform.s: The test was ___ difficult, so many students failed.
wordform.why: ขยาย adjective (difficult) ต้องใช้ adverb
หลัง is ต้องเป็น adjective และความหมาย 'เป็นอันตราย' = harmful (harmless = ไม่มีอันตราย ความหมายกลับ)
